name: invictus-grid-workspace
description: Root task runner for the Invictus Grid Workspace monorepo.

scripts.setup: npm run backend:install && npm run frontend:install
scripts.db:up: docker run -d --name igw-postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=invictus_grid -p 5432:5432 -v igw-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data --restart unless-stopped postgres:16
scripts.db:down: docker stop igw-postgres && docker rm igw-postgres
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it igw-postgres psql -U postgres -d invictus_grid
scripts.lint: npm run backend:lint && npm run frontend:lint
scripts.format: npm run backend:format && npm run frontend:format
scripts.format:check: npm run backend:format:check && npm run frontend:format:check
